AUTHORING THE SOURCE — what the Python body must look like:
  • A self-contained script. The call's arguments arrive as a dict named `input`.
  • Network/IO only via the injected `tools` object, all calls SYNCHRONOUS:
      tools.kv.get/set/delete/list      — small structured state
      tools.http.fetch(url, ...)         — GET, allowlisted hosts only
      tools.forward.<server>.<tool>(...) — wired external MCP servers
      tools.files.read/write/list/delete — persistent workspace
  • Standard library only — assume no third-party packages.
  • Print concise JSON to stdout; that is the tool's result. Handle missing
    input keys and failed tools.* calls explicitly rather than crashing.
  • Prove it first: run via `execute` until ok:true before promoting here.
Full namespace schemas: list_tools(schemas=true).

def append_architectural_decision(body, summary, sha)
  anchor  = "## Architectural Decisions"
  entry   = "- `#{sha[0,7]}`: #{summary.strip}"
  if body.include?(anchor)
    body.sub(/#{Regexp.escape(anchor)}/, "#{anchor}\n#{entry}")
    # prepend newest entry under the heading so chronological order is top-down
  else
    "#{body.rstrip}\n\n#{anchor}\n#{entry}\n"
  end
end

BatchPrSweeper#perform(batch_id):
  return unless Minions::PrPoller.enabled?    # reuse existing gate

  batch    = Batch.find_by(id: batch_id)
  return unless batch

  watching = batch.minions.where(state: "running", phase: "watching_pr").to_a
  return if watching.empty?

  BatchRefresher.new(watching).run             # one GraphQL query, distribute results

  watching.each do |minion|
    Minions::Orchestrator.new.evaluate(minion, source: :pr_poller)
  end

  minion_still_watching = batch.minions.where(state: "running", phase: "watching_pr").exists?
  self.class.perform_in(INTERVAL, batch_id) if minion_still_watching

BatchRefresher#run:
  return if @minions.empty?

  access_token = Github.installation_token(repos: repos_for(@minions)).token
  pr_numbers   = @minions.map { |m| [m, extract_pr_number(m.pr_url)] }.to_h   # pr_url from OpeningPr result
  query        = build_batch_graphql_query(pr_numbers.values.compact, repo_full_name: repo_full_name)
  data         = Github::GraphQl.query(query: query, access_token: access_token)  # single round-trip

  @minions.each do |minion|
    pr_n = pr_numbers[minion]
    next unless pr_n
    pr_data = data["pr_#{pr_n}"]                                                # aliased in the query
    next unless pr_data
    dispatch_single(minion, pr_data)                                            # normalise + call Refresher sub-step
  end

SeedService#seed_from_epic(epic_key, batch_params:):
  tickets = tracker.children_of(epic_key)   # one Jira HTTP call; [TicketRef]
  batch = Batch.create!(state: "draft", jira_epic_key: epic_key,
                        writeback_config: batch_params[:writeback_config],
                        **batch_params.except(:writeback_config))
  tickets.each do |ref|
    Minion.create!(batch: batch, prompt: build_prompt(ref),
                   jira_key: ref.key, jira_snapshot: ref.to_snapshot_h, **minion_defaults)
  end
  Events.emit(subject: batch, type: "trackers.seeded_from_epic",
              payload: { epic_key:, ticket_count: tickets.size })
  batch

WritebackService#on_pr_opened(minion):
  return unless minion.jira_key.present?
  return unless minion.batch&.writeback_config&.dig("transition_on_pr_open")
  tracker.transition(minion.jira_key, to: "In Review")
  Events.emit(subject: minion, type: "trackers.transitioned",
              payload: { jira_key: minion.jira_key, to: "In Review", trigger: "pr_opened" })

WritebackService#on_pr_merged(minion):  # same shape → "Done", trigger "pr_merged"

WritebackService#create_tickets_from_plan(batch):
  return unless batch.writeback_config&.dig("create_tickets_from_plan")
  batch.minions.where(jira_key: nil).each do |m|
    key = tracker.create({ summary: m.display_title, description: m.prompt })
    m.update!(jira_key: key, jira_snapshot: { summary: m.display_title, description: m.prompt })
    Events.emit(subject: m, type: "trackers.created", payload: { jira_key: key, minion_id: m.id })
  end

verb(batch, selector, ..., actor:):
  minions = resolve(batch, selector)          # raises OutOfBatchError on scope escape
  minions.each do |minion|
    Minion.with_advisory_lock("minion:#{minion.id}", timeout_seconds: 5) do
      minion.reload
      next if minion.terminal?                # idempotent: skip terminal Minions
      apply_mutation(minion, ...)
      Events.emit(
        subject: minion,
        type:    "steering.<verb>",
        payload: { selector: selector.to_h, actor_type: actor.class.name, diff: ... },
        actor:   actor,
        batch_id: batch.id
      )
    end
  end
